Use color coding (e.g., Red for HP, Yellow for Credits) to make the data instantly readable without reading the labels. 4. **Scale Adjustment:** Increase the scale of the 'START' button to make it the clear 'Call to Action,' while slightly reducing the size of the upgrade cards to indicate they are secondary options.
